title: Should the dashboard's emergency-sell and force-sell controls reach failed-held positions?

options.name: Keep current behaviour: the controls and the position list select trades.status = 'pending' buys only
options.risk: A held position whose exit failed through the catch path cannot be sold from the dashboard: force-sell answers 404 'Trade not found or already closed', emergency sell reports 'No open positions to sell' (or a clean success) while the tokens remain, and the position is not listed (AUD-API-001, S1 STRAND).

options.name: Select open positions the way getResumeExitMonitorTrades does: status = 'pending' buys UNION exit_state.exit_status = 'exit_failed_held', in the controls, the position list and the open/closed label
options.behavior_impact: Failed-held positions appear in Open Positions with a Force Sell button and are included in emergency sell; trade history shows them as open; balanceOf inside executeFullSell still decides whether anything is sold.
options.risk: The routine pause still refuses these sells unless card EXIT-07 also gives operator sells their own path; counts and totals on the dashboard change.

options.name: Stop marking still-held positions trades.status = 'failed' (keep 'pending', or add a distinct 'held_failed' status) so every pending-only query includes them, with the failure shown from exit_state
options.behavior_impact: Every status-filtered query (dashboard and risk limits) counts the position as open without per-query unions.
options.risk: Changes the meaning of trades.status for the risk queries too (overlaps card DB-01 and AUD-DB-003) and needs a migration of existing rows; the "failed" visibility the current code wants must move to exit_state.

recommendation: Decide together with DB-01 (what the risk limits count as open) and EXIT-07 (operator sells versus the routine pause); either change option closes the gap, keep-current does not. This is an S1 capital item (ESC-PRE-04) and cannot rest on the default.
default: Keep current behaviour until Phase 24 rules (milestone contract). This card covers an S1 capital finding, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides whether a still-held position whose exit failed can be seen and sold from the dashboard.
needed_by: Phase 24 capital discussion (AUDIT-05), before Wave A
